newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE BEAT NATAL 45-40 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FREE STATE BEAT NATAL 45-40 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.

text.p: Free State beat Natal 45-40 (halftime 27-16) in their Super 12 rugby union match on Saturday.
Free State - Tries: Jaco Coetzee, Braam Els, Chris Badenhorst. Conversions: Jannie de Beer (2), M.J.Smith. Penalties: Jorrie Kruger, Smith(7).
Natal - Tries: Dirkie Strydom, Wayne Fyvie, John Allan, Ollie le Roux, Gary Teichmann. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (3). Penalties: Lawless (3).
